query:
UPDATE twitch_hype_train_events
                   SET ended_at = $1,
                       duration_seconds = $2,
                       level = COALESCE($3, level),
                       total_progress = COALESCE($4, total_progress)
                 WHERE twitch_user_id = $5
                   AND started_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $6
                   AND ended_at IS NULL
